items.stem: What is a search engine mainly doing for you?

options.A: Finding existing pages or records that match your query
options.B: Inventing brand-new facts with no source

items.stem: What is a generative AI assistant mainly doing when it writes?

options.A: Opening every website live before each word
options.B: Producing new wording from patterns it learned
options.C: Storing your company's private files by default

items.stem: You need a verified street address from a government site. Best first move?

options.A: Ask the AI to invent one that sounds right
options.B: Trust the first social post you see
options.C: Search and open the official source

items.stem: AI helps problem solving most when you:

options.A: Break the task into steps, try options, and check results
options.B: Accept the first paragraph with no review
options.C: Avoid stating the goal so the AI can guess

items.stem: Search is usually stronger than pure generation for:

options.A: Locating a specific existing document or number
options.B: Brainstorming playful taglines with no fact check needed
options.C: Rewording a paragraph in a friendlier tone

items.stem: Generation is often stronger than plain search for:

options.A: Proving a legal claim with citations only
options.C: Drafting a first version of an email or outline

options.A: Search for sources, AI for draft structure, you for final check
options.B: AI only, never open another tab

items.stem: If an AI answer and a trusted source disagree on a date, you should:

options.B: Prefer the trusted source and recheck
options.C: Delete the source and keep the AI line

items.stem: "Solving" with AI still fails when you:

options.A: Give a clear goal and constraints
options.C: Skip checking any claim that must be true
